description: Seller side: sell one delivered job's pending credit to the house at the factoring_quote price. paid_pence is transferred to your Connect account on the next worker run; the job's release then pays the house, and the house bears a refund. One sale per job: a repeat returns it. Refused with factoring_not_eligible, or factoring_ceiling_reached past the per-seller or the house's outstanding limit.
